US To Sell $13 Bln In Reopened 19-Year 11-Month Bonds Tue
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $13 billion in reopened 19-year 11-month bonds Tuesday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 18, 2026 and will mature Aug. 15, 2046.
The debt is a reopening of an issue first sold on Aug. 31, 2026.The coupon is set at 5.125%.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 19-year 11-month bonds, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 12:00 PM Eastern Time Tuesday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 1:00 PM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
